{"verdict": "WRITE", "memory": "- Watchdog false-positive kills full `npm test` suites (2026-10-26): three consecutive full-suite runs (PR 2380, 2391, 2394 on builder-a/b/c) were Ctrl+C'd at exactly 61m by the stuck-judge (\"no output change\"). In at least one case the workers were still at 100% CPU, so the suite was busy but quiet, not hung. Why: the stuck heuristic only looks at output change, and the full suite can go more than 60m without new output. That makes full-suite verification impossible to finish and wastes about 1h per attempt. How to apply: before starting another full-suite run, fix the watchdog. Options are to exempt or extend the timeout for long test commands, to add a CPU or process-activity check to the stuck judge, or to run the suite with a reporter that prints progress regularly. You can also shard the suite. Don't report a PR suite as failing when the watchdog killed it."}

{"verdict": "WRITE", "memory": "- [Full-suite test runs hang at ~60m on PR work (2026-10-26)] — On 2026-10-26, three independent `npm test` full-suite runs (PR 2380, 2391, 2394, by builder-a/b/c) were each stalled at ~61 min with no output change and their test workers pegged at 100% CPU; the watchdog sent Ctrl+C in every case, and the team reported the pattern to topic 52075. Why it matters: this is a recurring suite-level hang, not a per-PR flake, so retrying or reading the watchdog's 60-min cutoff as the cause wastes time. How to apply: when a full suite stalls near the 1h mark with busy workers, treat it as a suite/worker-level problem (investigate the hanging test or worker pool, e.g. run with a single worker or per-file to bisect) rather than a transient; consider raising the stuck-judge threshold only after confirming the suites are actually progressing rather than deadlocked. Related: [[studio-sync-serendipity-timeouts]] (existing MEMORY.md note on Studio sync hangs and serendipity patch timeouts, likely the same class of hang)."}

{"verdict": "WRITE", "memory": "- Watchdog false-positive on full test suites (2026-10-26): the stuck-judge (\"no output change\") killed `npm test` at ~61m in 3/3 full-suite runs (builder-a PR 2380, builder-b PR 2391, builder-c PR 2394). builder-a's suite still had workers at 100% CPU, so it was busy, not hung. Topic 52075 says this is recurring (\"died at the 1h mark again\"). Why: silent-but-busy long runs look stuck to an output-only heuristic, so no full suite can finish and PR verification stalls. How to apply: until the watchdog checks CPU/child-process activity or exempts suite commands, don't launch full suites expecting them to finish under the watchdog. Shard the suite, use a reporter that prints progress, or run outside watchdog supervision, and fix the stuck-judge heuristic."}
